verdict.rationale: Kling documents an Elements system in 3.0 Omni for persistent character identity and voice across multiple shots and scenes, which directly addresses consistency beyond a single clip. This is reinforced by multi-shot storyboarding of up to 6 cuts and by claims of a consistent visual style across image series. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how Elements works and its limits (e.g. scene/environment consistency, not just characters), and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-shot consistency.
